status_evidence: origin/main da67341: main.ts:1718-1721 launch() calls preview(cfg) -> setupViews -> scene.prewarm (main.ts:1715) even when the config was just previewed; pads.ts:347-381 ~27k noisy vertices; liveries.ts paintBody 2048 canvases; recovery.ts uncached materials. MEASURED (perf-baseline/results/baseline-fbefa18.md, fbefa18, same render code on da67341): launchEnter creates 19 shader programs of which 18 are identical to one already linked in the same context, flightStart 19/19 identical; 2.0-2.8 s waiting on compile/link and 2 long tasks (2.6-3.7 s) under SwiftShader - i.e. disposing the old views releases programs that the new views immediately recompile.

BEFORE building the new views, so three.js releases each program (usedTimes 0) and recompiles it. title: prefers-reduced-motion ignored by launch scene camera easing, shake and Orbit animation
